audit_basis.assignment_pdf_review_source: Original assignment PDF reviewed; detailed requirements and data-audit instructions specify 1,000 test images.

image_preprocessing.source_operation: PIL ImageOps.exif_transpose, RGB conversion, LANCZOS thumbnail preserving aspect ratio, centered black letterbox
image_preprocessing.normalization: CLIP processor at embedding time; normalization is not baked into JPEGs

captions.tokenization: NFKC; casefold; Unicode letter/number tokens; internal straight/curly apostrophes retained; no stemming/lemmatization

visual_diversity.method: 96x96 RGB samples; coarse HSV family quantization; luminance/saturation; Pillow FIND_EDGES threshold proxy

validation_preprocessing.evaluation_scope: geometry criteria only; not downstream model performance

test_size_note.interpretation: The original assignment's detailed dataset and preprocessing requirements specify 1,000 test images. One occurrence contains the typographical value 1,00; the detailed requirements and data-audit instructions establish 1,000 as intended.

missing_requirements: Historical per-image EXIF correction and grayscale/RGBA conversion counts were not retained.

limitations: No caption generation or caption metric evaluation is implemented in Phase 1.

Nine current pHash candidates are within-split review candidates and are not asserted duplicates.
